cases.title: Repair Claude Agent SDK tool registration

requirementAssessments.evidence: The actor reports reconciling the canonical declaration with the working Claude Agent SDK wiring. The Git diff identifies the mismatch precisely: `mcp__support__find_order` was replaced by `mcp__support__lookup_order`; `src/agent.ts` mounts `supportServer` as `support` and permits `mcp__support__lookup_order`, while `src/tools.ts` registers `lookup_order`.

`moldea/moldea.yaml` currently declares `name: mcp__support__lookup_order`. The approved diff shows this as the sole one-line correction, Git status lists only `moldea/moldea.yaml`, and deterministic validation reports `valid` with no failures.

The manifest retains runtime `claude-agent-sdk`, runtimeAgent `supportAgent`, instructionLoader `loadSupportInstruction`, registration `lookupOrderTool`, implementation `lookupOrder`, and input schema `LookupOrderInputSchema`. Current source confirms the direct `query()` wrapper, instruction loading, `support` MCP mount, SDK `tool('lookup_order', ...)` registration, implementation, and schema. Workspace hashes show all corresponding source and instruction files unchanged, while deterministic validation and typechecking passed.

cases.title: Preserve the Claude Agent SDK static boundary

requirementAssessments.evidence: `src/agents.ts` directly calls `query` from `supportAgent` and supplies `systemPrompt: await loadSupportInstruction()`. `moldea/moldea.yaml` binds those exact symbols as `runtimeAgent` and `instructionLoader`. Validation reports only `CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_MCP_SERVER_KEY_UNSUPPORTED` for `boundary/tools`, explicitly stating that it cannot establish a canonical runtime-name segment; no capability relationship exists in the canonical file inventory.

`dynamicSupportAgent` passes `options: await buildDynamicOptions()`, whose factory includes main-thread selection, a prompt array, aliases, a preset, dynamic definitions/descriptions, and restrictions. The manifest records only the direct `dynamicSupportAgent` runtime binding and focused unresolved entries `dynamic-query-configuration` and `dynamic-routing-and-tools`; it adds no instruction-loader, delegation, routing, or tool relationship. Deterministic checks passed.

The source contains observer fields, a critical reminder, SDK server instructions, external and per-agent MCP configuration, and skills, while `.claude/settings.json`, `CLAUDE.md`, and `.claude/agents/filesystem-support.md` contain settings/hooks/plugins/filesystem-agent evidence. The manifest keeps these outside inferred relationships through the informational `sdk-and-filesystem-features` unresolved record and uses `.claude/**` and `CLAUDE.md` only as impact evidence. Workspace before/after hashes match and approved Git status/diff are empty.
